defects.description: Any exception from gateway.charge is caught and the function returns None. Stock reserved at line 25 is never released, and the caller cannot distinguish a declined payment from a duplicate cart (also None), so the UI shows no error and the reserved stock stays locked.

On TimeoutError the call is repeated with no idempotency key. If the first request was actually captured by the gateway, the retry creates a second charge for the same cart and the customer is billed twice.

Duplicate-cart protection relies on the process-local dict _recent_orders. With multiple worker processes or after a restart the dict is empty or differs per process, so a double submission is not detected and a second order and charge are created.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS is an immutable module-level configuration constant, read-only at runtime; it is not mutable shared state.
Optional collaborator injection with a default implementation is a standard constructor-injection pattern; callers and tests can pass a substitute.
